description: Search the Formada3D shop (3D-printed paint racks, desk & home organisers, wall planters, Mac mounts, collectibles display, kids wooden-railway track parts, custom letters, cookie cutters, tabletop terrain, STL files). Relevance-ranked; live AUD prices from our price list (no GST); made to order in Melbourne, Australia. Returns product URL and add_to_cart_url.

category.description: Optional category filter (see list_categories), e.g. "Paint racks", "planters", "Kids".

digital.description: true = STL files only, false = physical products only.

max_price.description: Optional max starting price in AUD.

query.description: What the person wants, e.g. "rack for vallejo dropper bottles" (optional; empty = everything).
